1  The Police-Sub-Inspector, Basavanagudi Women Police Station, Bangalore has filed charge sheet against the accused No.1 and 2 for the offences punishable U/s.498(A) of IPC.
 2.
The brief facts of the prosecution case are that:
That the Accused No.1 got married to Cw-1 on 30-03-012 at SRS Kalyana mantapa, Shankara mutt, Hassan and begotten a male child
. After the marriage, CW-1 started residing at Hassan and after the death mother of Accused No.1 they shifted to Bengaluru.

Accused No.2 arranged house at Chikkalasandra,
Sarvabouma nagar, Bengaluru.

Later Accused No.1 started ill treating the CW-1 by listening the words of Accused-2, Accused No.1 abused her and pressurized CW-1 to bring more dowry from her parents house and tortured both by physically and mentally in demand of dowry and threatened her to give divorce  3  C.C.No.3271/2017 and marry other girl.

It is further alleged that, when Accused No.1 and 2 were involved in some crime and were in J C at that time, CW-1 has given Rs.20,000/- and got them released on bail and had given Rs.20,000/- to lawyer as fees and after release accused were not coming home and staying in sister's house and were not providing basic necessities to her and her child.
When she questioned the same, Accused drove away her out from matrimonial home in demand of more dowry and thereby accused persons have committed aforesaid offences.
3. The accused No.1 and 2 were enlarged on bail.

On receipt of charge sheet, this court took the cognizance of the alleged offence and furnished copy of the prosecution papers to the Manjula vs Charan on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127287272/
2 accused persons.

Charge for the offences P/U/S.498A of IPC. was framed, read over and explained to the accused No.1 and 2.
Accused No.1 and 2 pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
Thereafter the matter was posted for evidence.
In support of the case of prosecution, in spite of repeated issuance of summons and warrants the jurisdictional police fails to secure the presence of CW 1 to 6.
Hence, the prayer of Sr.APP is rejected and CW-1 to 6 are dropped.
As none of the witnesses are examined by the prosecution and no evidence against the accused No.1 and 2 the recording of Statement of Accused as required U/s. 313 of Cr.P.C., is dispensed with.
5. I have heard the arguments of learned Sr.APP., for the prosecution and learned counsel for the accused.
Perused the materials available on record.

6. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused No.1 and 2 caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  and thereby accused have committed the offences  punishable U/s.498A of IPC. ?
 2) what order?
 7.

My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:
 5  C.C.No.3271/2017  REASONS  8.

The witnesses cited in the charge sheet did not appeared and lead their evidence and there are no materials against Manjula vs Charan on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127287272/
3 accused No.1 and 2 as Cws. 1 to 6 were not secured by the prosecution and they are dropped.

This court issued summons,
warrant and proclamation to Cws.1 to 6.
But the concerned police could not secure the presence of the witnesses in-spite of issuance of several times process by this court.
Moreover this case is of the year 2017.
The Cws.1 to 6 may not be secured in near future days.
Hence, prayer of Sr.APP to reissue witness summons to Cw's was rejected and CW-1 to 6 are dropped and prosecution side evidence is taken as Nil.
Since there is no incriminating evidence appeared against the accused, the statement of accused U/s.313 of Cr.P.C. was dispensed with.
In the absence of evidence of Cws.1 to 6, there are no material to show that the accused have committed the offence punishable u/s. 498A of IPC.
Hence, I hold that the prosecution has utterly  6  C.C.No.3271/2017 failed to prove the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
9. POINT No.2:-

For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following;
 ORDER Acting Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., accused No.1 and 2 are hereby acquitted of the offence punishable U/s.498A of IPC.
The bail bond and surety bond of accused No.1 and 2 shall stands cancelled.
